The (dominantly) shifted Drinfeld twisted Yangian associated to the matrix $\sigma$ is the algebra ${}^{\textnormal{Dr}}{\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{+}(\sigma)$ over $\mathbb{C}$
generated by $\{\mathsf{h}_{i,r}\}_{r\geqslant 0}$ , $\{\mathsf{b}_{j,r}\}_{r\geqslant\mathfrak{s}_{j+1,j}}$ , for $0\leqslant i

(8.14)

$\displaystyle[\mathsf{h}_{i,r},\mathsf{h}_{j,s}]$
$\displaystyle=0,\qquad{\mathsf{h}_{i,2r}=0,}$

(8.15)

$\displaystyle[\mathsf{h}_{i,r+1},\mathsf{b}_{j,s}]-[\mathsf{h}_{i,r-1},\mathsf{b}_{j,s+2}]$
$\displaystyle=c_{ij}\{\mathsf{h}_{i,r-1},\mathsf{b}_{j,s+1}\}+\frac{1}{4}c_{ij}^{2}[\mathsf{h}_{i,r-1},\mathsf{b}_{j,s}],$

(8.16)

$\displaystyle[\mathsf{b}_{i,r+1},\mathsf{b}_{j,s}]-[\mathsf{b}_{i,r},\mathsf{b}_{j,s+1}]$
$\displaystyle=\frac{c_{ij}}{2}\{\mathsf{b}_{i,r},\mathsf{b}_{j,s}\}-2\delta_{ij}(-1)^{r}\mathsf{h}_{i,r+s+1},$

(8.17)

$\displaystyle[\mathsf{b}_{i,r},\mathsf{b}_{j,s}]$
$\displaystyle=0,\qquad\text{ for }|i-j|>1,$

(8.18)

$\displaystyle\mathrm{Sym}_{k_{1},k_{2}}\big[\mathsf{b}_{i,k_{1}},[\mathsf{b}_{i,k_{2}},\mathsf{b}_{j,r}]\big]$

$\displaystyle=(-1)^{k_{1}}\sum_{p\geqslant 0}2^{-2p}\big($
$\displaystyle[\mathsf{h}_{i,k_{1}+k_{2}-2p-1},\mathsf{b}_{j,r+1}]-\{\mathsf{h}_{i,k_{1}+k_{2}-2p-1},\mathsf{b}_{j,r}\}\big),\qquad\text{ if }c_{i,j}=-1.$

for all admissible indices $i,j,r,s$ . Here by convention, $\mathsf{h}_{i,-1}=1$ .

If $\sigma$ is the zero matrix, then one recovers the Drinfeld presentation of twisted Yangians; see [LWZ23, Thm. 5.1]. The definition naturally extends to the symmetric Cartan matrices (i.e. simply laced types), which correspond to shifted twisted Yangians of split ADE type; cf. [LWZ25]. In the context of the current paper, the Drinfeld shifted twisted Yangians are associated to $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}$ . To obtain the $\mathfrak{sl}_{N}$ version, one only needs to exclude the generators $\mathsf{h}_{0,r}$ .
card.label: Definition 8.7

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and finite $W$-algebras of classical type
paper.abstract: We introduce parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians of types AI and AII, interpolating between the R-matrix presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. Then we formulate and provide parabolic presentations for the shifted twisted Yangians. We define quotient algebras known as truncated shifted twisted Yangians and equip them with baby comultiplications, generalizing the work of Brundan and Kleshchev. PBW bases for all (truncated) shifted twisted Yangians of type AI and AII are established along the way. Applying the theory of universal equivariant quantizations of conic symplectic singularities we show that the truncated twisted shifted Yangian is isomorphic to the finite $W$-algebra which quantizes a suitable Slodowy slice. This provides a presentation of the finite $W$-algebra associated with every even nilpotent element in type {\sf B} and {\sf C}, as well as every nilpotent element with two Jordan blocks in type {\sf D}. Finally we make a conjecture which would supply presentations in the remaining even cases in type {\sf D}.
